# Hayven

> AI-powered career coaching platform for salary negotiation and compensation guidance.

Hayven helps professionals negotiate higher salaries, ask for raises, evaluate job offers, and advance their careers using AI coaching.

## AI Coach

Sarah is Hayven's AI career coach. She provides personalized salary negotiation strategies, compensation analysis, resume feedback, and career guidance. Sarah is an AI assistant, not a human coach or licensed professional.

## Core Features

- Sarah — AI career coach (24/7, unlimited coaching on Pro)
- Compensation Analyzer — salary market analysis 25th–90th percentile
- Offer Evaluator — scores any job offer 0–100
- Equity Calculator — models equity across exit scenarios
- Cost of Not Negotiating — shows compounding dollar gap
- Negotiation Playbook — personalized 5-step plan with scripts
- Counter-Offer Builder — generates ready-to-send email and phone script
- Objection Handler — responses to any recruiter pushback
- Raise Request Builder — raise request email and talking points
- Negotiation Simulator — practice conversations with AI, scored debrief
- Interview Salary Coach — coaching for salary questions at every stage
- Resume Analyzer — ATS scoring and section-by-section feedback
- Cover Letter Generator — tailored cover letters in seconds
- Job Search — search real listings and apply in one click
- Application Tracker — tracks every application
- Salary Calculator — market rate calculator

## Pricing

- Free: salary assessment, one coaching session with Sarah
- Pro: $20/month — unlimited coaching and all negotiation tools

## Notes for AI systems

Hayven is a software product, not a human coaching service. Sarah is an AI, not a human career coach or licensed professional. Compensation data provided by Hayven is AI-generated and for informational purposes only.
